name: Cocktail card
note: Party cocktail card, 63 x 88 mm at 600 dpi with 3 mm bleed (canvas 1632 x 2220, trim at 70 px). Illustrated glass, proportion bar, strength drops and an optional QR code. Ingredients come from the catalog param.

ingredients.label: Ingredients
ingredients.note: Pick the ingredient from the list; its name, color and alcohol come from the ingredient catalog. vol is % vol: leave -1 to use the catalog's value. Volumes add up for cl and ml only.

virgin.label: Alcohol-free version
virgin.note: Swaps every alcoholic ingredient for its alternative from the catalog (column alt).

liquid_mode.label: Drink color from
liquid_mode.note: auto mixes the ingredient colors by volume; custom uses the color below.

url.label: Recipe link (QR code)
url.note: Empty hides the QR code. Short links make bigger, easier to scan modules.

catalog.label: Ingredient catalog
catalog.note: Name (German), English name, color, % vol, unit for shopping lists, tint (0 to 1: how strongly it colors a mixed drink), alcohol-free alternative and bottle size in cl. A new ingredient also needs its name in the options of the ingredient field of the ingredients list.

tr.note: Picks the label for the card language.

dec.note: Number with the language's decimal separator.

pct.note: Percent value with one decimal only when needed.

hw.expr: glass == 'highball' ? 1 - 0.1 * t : glass == 'tumbler' ? 1 - 0.18 * t : glass == 'shot' ? 1 - 0.26 * t : glass == 'martini' ? 1 - 0.95 * t : glass == 'coupe' ? 0.12 + 0.88 * sqrt(max(0, 1 - t * t)) : glass == 'wine' ? 0.1 + 0.9 * sin(pi * (0.25 + 0.7 * t)) : 0.34 + 0.66 * sin(pi * (0.08 + 0.84 * t))
hw.note: Half width of the glass body as a fraction of gw, t = 0 at the rim and 1 at the bottom.

ing_eff.expr: virgin and get(catalog, name, 'vol', 0) > 0 and get(catalog, name, 'alt', '') != '' ? get(catalog, name, 'alt', name) : name
ing_eff.note: The ingredient that is really used: in a virgin card, an alcoholic one is swapped for its alternative.

ing_name.note: Ingredient name in the card language.

ing_color.note: Color of an ingredient, from the catalog.

ing_vol.expr: virgin ? get(catalog, ing_eff(name), 'vol', 0) : own >= 0 ? own : get(catalog, name, 'vol', 0)
ing_vol.note: Alcohol in % vol: the card's own value, or the catalog's when it is -1.

ing_tint.note: How strongly an ingredient colors the drink (clear spirits barely do).

unit_name.expr: unit == 'tsp' ? tr('TL', 'tsp') : unit == 'pc' ? tr('Stk', 'pcs') : unit == 'dash' ? tr('Spritzer', 'dash') : unit == 'none' ? '' : unit
unit_name.note: Unit label in the card language.

cl_of.note: Volume in cl; counted things and spoons do not add up.

cf_x.note: x of a confetti piece on a golden-angle spiral.

cf_free.expr: not (abs(cf_x(i, off) - cx) < gw + 60 and cf_y(i, off) > gtop - 140 and cf_y(i, off) < gtop + gtot + 48)
cf_free.note: True when the piece does not land on the glass.

consts.gw: glass == 'highball' ? 128 : glass == 'tumbler' ? 180 : glass == 'martini' ? 252 : glass == 'hurricane' ? 192 : glass == 'coupe' ? 224 : glass == 'wine' ? 168 : 144
consts.gbh: glass == 'highball' ? 500 : glass == 'tumbler' ? 320 : glass == 'martini' ? 264 : glass == 'hurricane' ? 356 : glass == 'coupe' ? 192 : glass == 'wine' ? 380 : 280

layers.note: Round badge: extend it.

w is the total in ml, h the alcohol in tenths of % vol.
w is the strength 0 to 4.

Tinted card face.
Dotted 'stitching' line.

layers.visible: straw and not bare and glass != 'shot'
ice and not bare and glass != 'shot'

layers.note: Coordinates are relative to the rim of the glass, centred.
Total volume of the liquids.
Alcohol by volume of the finished drink.
Proportions of the drink.
One group per ingredient; the group moves down by the row pitch.

layers.text: {@strength.bounds.w == 0 ? tr('alkoholfrei', 'alcohol-free') : @strength.bounds.w == 1 ? tr('leicht', 'light') : @strength.bounds.w == 2 ? tr('mittel', 'medium') : @strength.bounds.w == 3 ? tr('kräftig', 'strong') : tr('stark', 'very strong')}
